title: Axial and Appendicular Skeleton
purpose: Distinguish axial and appendicular skeleton organization.

direct_resource.Title: OpenStax: Divisions of the Skeletal System
direct_resource.Task: Click the link and use the axial skeleton introduction. Observe how skeletal organization is divided. Record axial, appendicular, and one example bone from each division.

mastery_rule: Student can explain the lesson standard with structure-function reasoning and visual/data evidence.
